home.h1: Online CA Services for Accounting, Tax, GST, Trademark, MCA and Compliance
home.sub: Eaccountingcart helps startups, businesses and professionals register, stay compliant and save tax. Fill your details online, upload your documents or WhatsApp them to us, and a qualified expert takes it from there.

home_faqs.a: We are a Delhi based CA firm offering the complete stack a business needs: company and LLP registration, GST registration and returns, income tax filing and notices, trademark and IPR protection, MCA and ROC compliance, government licenses like FSSAI and IEC, NGO registrations, NBFC and fintech licensing, environmental approvals and full accounting, payroll and CFO support. Every service page on this website explains the process, documents and timeline in plain language.

home_faqs.q: How do I share my documents with you?
home_faqs.a: Two ways, both online. Every service page has a secure form where you fill your details and upload documents directly from your phone or computer. Or simply tap the WhatsApp button and send your documents in chat. Our team confirms receipt, checks everything and tells you if anything is missing.

home_faqs.q: Do I need to visit your office to get work done?
home_faqs.a: No. The entire process is online for every service, from consultation and document collection to filing and delivery of certificates. We are based in Delhi and serve clients in every state of India. Clients who prefer to meet in person are always welcome by appointment.

home_faqs.q: How much do your services cost?
home_faqs.a: Fees depend on the service and your exact requirement, so we quote before we start, in writing, with government fees shown separately. There are no hidden charges at any stage. Share your requirement through the form or WhatsApp and you will receive a clear fixed quote, usually the same day.

home_faqs.q: How fast will someone respond after I submit an enquiry?
home_faqs.a: During working hours, our team typically responds within a couple of hours, and always by the same working day. WhatsApp messages usually get the fastest replies. Once your work starts, you get a single point of contact who keeps you updated at every stage.

home_faqs.q: Is my data and are my documents safe with you?
home_faqs.a: Yes. Documents uploaded through the website are stored securely and are accessible only to the team working on your assignment. As a professional CA firm we are bound by confidentiality obligations, and we never share client information with any third party without your consent.

home_faqs.q: Which structure should I choose to start my business?
home_faqs.a: It depends on your funding plans, liability comfort and running costs. As a rule of thumb: choose a private limited company if investors are on your roadmap, an LLP for professional services with partners, and a proprietorship to start small and quick. The honest answer needs a short conversation, and our first consultation is free.

home_faqs.q: Can you take over from my existing accountant or consultant?
home_faqs.a: Yes, and it happens often. We start with a review of your current filings and books, list anything pending or incorrect, fix what needs fixing and then take over the routine. The handover is managed so no deadline is missed in between.

home_faqs.q: What happens if I receive a tax or GST notice?
home_faqs.a: Send it to us on WhatsApp the day it arrives. We read it free of charge, explain in plain words what the department wants and what is at stake, and quote for the reply only if professional drafting is actually needed. Deadlines matter most with notices, so early review is everything.

home_faqs.q: Why should I choose Eaccountingcart over a big online platform?
home_faqs.a: You get the convenience of a platform with the accountability of a firm. Your work is handled by a qualified CA team that knows your file, not a ticket queue. The same team stays with you across years, registrations, filings and notices, which is exactly when continuity pays.

Eaccountingcart is a Chartered Accountant led firm based in Delhi, serving startups, small businesses, professionals and growing companies across India.

Who We Are

We started with a simple observation: business owners were losing time and money shuttling between an accountant, a company secretary, a trademark agent and a license consultant, with no one taking responsibility for the whole picture. Eaccountingcart brings all of it under one roof, with a qualified team that stays accountable end to end.

What We Do

From registering your business and protecting your brand to filing your taxes, managing your books and keeping every government deadline, we cover the complete compliance and finance needs of Indian businesses. Every engagement begins with an honest conversation about what you actually need, and a written quote before any work starts.

How We Work

Everything runs online. You share your details and documents through our website or WhatsApp, and a dedicated expert handles your work while keeping you updated at every stage. Deadlines are tracked in our systems, not in anyone's memory, so renewals and due dates never slip.

Our Promise

  • Advice first, invoice later: we tell you what you need, not what we sell
  • Fixed written quotes with government fees shown separately
  • A single point of contact who knows your file
  • Reminders before every due date that affects you
  • Complete confidentiality of your data and documents

Talk to Us

Whether you are starting up, scaling or fixing a compliance mess, the first consultation is free. Call us, WhatsApp us or fill the form on any page, and a member of our team will get back to you the same working day.

pages.title: Free Online Tools
pages.meta_title: Free Online Tax and Finance Tools | Eaccountingcart
pages.meta_description: Free calculators for Indian businesses and taxpayers: GST calculator, income tax old vs new regime, HRA exemption and business loan EMI. No signup needed.
pages.content:
Quick, free calculators built by our CA team. No signup, no data stored, instant answers on your phone or desktop.

[ktn_tools_grid]

Why We Built These Tools

Clients ask us the same quick questions every week: how much GST goes on this invoice, which tax regime saves more, how much of my HRA is exempt, what EMI will this loan carry. These tools answer them instantly. When the answer raises a bigger question, our team is one WhatsApp message away.

A Note on Accuracy

Each tool uses the current rules and rates and states its assumptions clearly below the results. They are close estimates for planning, not filing computations. For anything you will sign or file, have our team check the numbers, the first consultation is free.

children.title: GST Calculator
children.meta_title: GST Calculator Online | Add or Remove GST Instantly
children.meta_description: Free GST calculator: add GST to a base price or remove GST from a total. See CGST and SGST split for 5%, 12%, 18% and 28% rates instantly.
children.content:
Calculate GST both ways: add tax to a base price or work backwards from a price that already includes it, with the CGST and SGST split shown.

[ktn_gst_calculator]

How to Use This GST Calculator

Enter the amount, pick the GST rate that applies to your goods or services and choose the calculation type. Use add GST when your price is before tax and you want the invoice total. Use remove GST when you have a final price and need the base value and tax inside it.

Which GST Rate Applies to You?

Most services fall at 18 percent. Goods vary widely: essentials at 5 percent, standard goods at 12 or 18 percent and luxury or sin goods at 28 percent. The correct rate depends on your HSN or SAC classification, and getting it wrong invites notices. If you are unsure, ask us on WhatsApp with your product details.

CGST, SGST and IGST

For sales within your state, the tax splits equally into CGST and SGST. For interstate sales, the entire amount is charged as IGST. The total tax is the same either way; only the split changes.

children.title: Income Tax Calculator
children.meta_title: Income Tax Calculator | Old vs New Regime Comparison
children.meta_description: Free income tax calculator for India: compare old and new regime tax side by side with standard deduction, 87A rebate and cess included.
children.content:
Compare your income tax under the old and new regimes side by side and see which one saves you money this year.

[ktn_income_tax_calculator]

How to Use This Income Tax Calculator

Enter your gross annual income, tick the salaried box if you receive salary or pension (the standard deduction applies automatically) and enter your total old regime deductions such as 80C investments, health insurance, HRA and home loan interest. The calculator shows tax under both regimes and tells you plainly which is cheaper.

Old Regime or New Regime?

The new regime has lower slab rates but allows almost no deductions. The old regime has higher rates but rewards deductions. As a rough rule, if your deductions and exemptions are substantial, the old regime often wins; with few deductions, the new regime usually does. The only reliable answer is calculating both with your actual numbers, which is exactly what this tool and our ITR filing service do.

What This Estimate Includes

The calculation covers the current slabs, standard deduction, the section 87A rebate with marginal relief and 4 percent cess. It does not compute surcharge on incomes above fifty lakh rupees. Treat the result as a close planning estimate rather than a final filing computation.

children.title: HRA Exemption Calculator
children.meta_title: HRA Exemption Calculator | How Much HRA is Tax Free
children.meta_description: Free HRA calculator: find your tax free house rent allowance under section 10(13A) using salary, rent paid and metro city rules.
children.content:
Find out how much of your house rent allowance escapes tax under section 10(13A), using the three limb rule the law prescribes.

[ktn_hra_calculator]

How HRA Exemption is Calculated

The exempt amount is the lowest of three figures: the HRA you actually received, rent paid minus 10 percent of basic salary plus DA, and 50 percent of basic plus DA in metro cities (40 percent elsewhere). Whatever remains of your HRA after the exemption is taxable as salary.

Documents That Protect Your HRA Claim

Keep rent receipts and the rent agreement, pay rent through bank transfer rather than cash where possible, and collect your landlord's PAN if annual rent exceeds one lakh rupees. Claims without this paper trail are the ones that fail in scrutiny.

HRA and the New Regime

HRA exemption is available only under the old tax regime. If your HRA and other deductions are large, the old regime may beat the new one, which you can verify in our income tax calculator or have us confirm when filing your return.

children.title: Business Loan EMI Calculator
children.meta_title: Business Loan EMI Calculator | Monthly EMI and Interest
children.meta_description: Free EMI calculator for business and term loans: monthly EMI, total interest and total repayment from loan amount, rate and tenure.
children.content:
Check the monthly EMI, total interest cost and total repayment for any business loan, term loan or machinery finance before you sign.

[ktn_emi_calculator]

How to Read the Results

The EMI is your fixed monthly outflow. Total interest shows what the loan truly costs over its life, which is the number to compare across bank offers. A longer tenure lowers the EMI but raises total interest, so match the tenure to the cash flow the loan will generate.

Before You Apply for a Business Loan

Banks assess your application on financial ratios, projected cash flows and a credible project report or CMA data. Applications with weak documentation get under sanctioned or rejected even when the business is sound. Our team prepares bank ready project reports and handles banker queries until sanction.

Interest Rates and Fees

This calculator assumes a fixed rate with monthly rests, which is how most term loans work. Also budget for processing fees, typically 0.5 to 2 percent, and check for prepayment charges before signing the sanction letter.

pages.title: Privacy Policy
pages.meta_description: How Eaccountingcart collects, uses and protects your personal information and documents submitted through this website.
pages.content:
This policy explains how Eaccountingcart collects, uses and protects the information you share with us through this website, WhatsApp, email or phone.

Information We Collect

When you submit an enquiry or upload documents, we collect the details you provide: your name, contact information, the service you are interested in, your message and any documents you attach. We also collect basic technical information that all websites receive, such as browser type, for security and performance.

How We Use Your Information

  • To respond to your enquiry and provide the services you request
  • To prepare and file applications, returns and documents on your instructions
  • To send you updates about your work and reminders about due dates that affect you
  • To meet our legal and professional obligations

Document Security

Documents you upload are stored securely and are accessible only to team members working on your assignment. We do not sell or share your personal information or documents with third parties for marketing. Information is disclosed only where required to complete your work (for example, filing with a government portal) or where the law requires it.

Data Retention

We retain engagement records for the periods professional and tax regulations require. If you would like enquiry data deleted where no engagement followed, contact us and we will action it.

Cookies

This website uses only essential cookies needed for its basic operation and does not run third party advertising trackers.

Contact

For any privacy question or request, contact us through the details on our Contact page.
